name: calendar_events_list
description: Returns events on the specified calendar. (GET /calendars/{calendarId}/events)

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method.

time_min.description: Lower bound (exclusive) for an event's end time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp, e.g. 2026-01-19T00:00:00Z.

time_max.description: Upper bound (exclusive) for an event's start time to filter by. Must be an RFC3339 timestamp.

q.description: Free text search terms to find events that match these terms in the summary, description, location, or attendees' emails and display names.

single_events.description: Whether to expand recurring events into instances and only return single one-off events and instances of recurring events, but not the underlying recurring events themselves. Default False.

show_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted events (with status equal to 'cancelled') in the result. Default False.

max_results.description: Maximum number of events returned on one result page. Default 30.
